processing_steps_notes.value: Three low-density steel grades (including 15Mn5Ni) were prepared by vacuum induction melting route; a 30 kg ingot was produced and its sound portion was used.

source.reason: Block b0015 states the three LDS grades were prepared by vacuum induction melting and describes the 30 kg ingot.

processing_steps_notes.value: Sound portion of the 30 kg ingot homogenized at 1423 K for 2.5 h.

source.reason: Block b0015 states the sound portion of the ingot was homogenized at 1423 K for 2.5 h.

processing_steps_notes.value: Hot rolled at 1323 K; final thickness of hot rolled plate about 13 mm. This condition is referred to as HR.

source.reason: Block b0015 states hot rolling at 1323 K with a final plate thickness of ~13 mm; the HR designation is defined here.

processing_steps_notes.value: Samples cut from hot-rolled plates were cold rolled at room temperature to ~50% reduction in thickness (~6 mm thick sheets) in several passes; 15Mn5Ni cracked beyond 50% cold reduction so further reduction was not carried out. The cold rolled condition is denoted HR+CR.

source.reason: Block b0015 and b0008 state cold rolling to ~50% reduction in thickness at room temperature and note that 15Mn5Ni cracked beyond 50% reduction.

method.value: heat treatment at 873 K followed by water quenching

processing_steps_notes.value: Cold rolled sheets were heat treated in the temperature range 873 K–1273 K for 1 h followed by water quenching; heat-treated samples are referred to by the heat treatment temperature. This sample corresponds to the 873 K condition, which is documented for hardness only.

source.reason: Block b0015 states the cold rolled sheets were heat treated in the range 873 K–1273 K for 1 h followed by water quenching, with samples referred to by heat treatment temperature; block b0046 reports the hardness result at 873 K.

type.value: annealing twins (lower fraction than higher-Mn LDS alloys)

morphology.value: elongated stringers (bamboo-like morphology) and polygonal particles

type.value: planar slip bands (parallel slip bands); no deformation twinning or martensite transformation

morphology.value: deformed, with parallel planar slip bands
elongated stringers that underwent concurrent deformation with austenite; average thickness reduced from ~8 μm to ~2 μm and eventually sheared and fragmented (~35–45° to rolling direction)

region.value: bulk (cold-rolled sheet, precursor state to 873 K heat treatment)

overall_structure.value: Fe–15Mn–9Al-0.9C–5Ni (15Mn5Ni) is a Ni-containing lower-Mn austenitic low-density steel whose microstructure consists of a γ-austenite matrix together with ordered B2 (Fe(Ni)Al-type) phase and κ-carbide precipitates; in the hot-rolled (HR) condition the B2 fraction (~12%) is higher than in the higher-Mn 28Mn5Ni alloy (~4%), and the alloy possesses the highest κ-carbide volume fraction among the three alloys.

source.reason: Overall structure and HR-condition features (B2 ~12%, equiaxed γ ~5–7 μm, κ-carbides, twins) are described for 15Mn5Ni in blocks b0025/b0026/b0084; the HR+CR precursor state (deformed austenite with planar slip and sheared/fragmented B2 stringers, thickness ~8→2 μm) is described in b0026/b0027 and figure_001. The 873 K state itself was not separately characterized.
